prompt: Trong không gian <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>O</mi><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi><mi>z</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, cho tam giác <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mi>N</mi><mi>P</mi></mrow></semantics></math> biết các điểm <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>;</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>N</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>;</mo><mi>m</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>. Tìm <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mi>m</mi></semantics></math> để tam giác <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mi>N</mi><mi>P</mi></mrow></semantics></math> vuông tại <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mi>N</mi></semantics></math>.
solution:
Ta có NM→=(3;2;−2), NP→=(2;m−2;1).
Tam giác MNP vuông tại N khi
NM→⋅NP→=0⇔3⋅2+2⋅(m−2)+(−2)⋅1=0⇔m=0.
